purpose: Owner selects the road in original B cartoon board's gameplay strip as the visual reference; preserve natural winding form and explicit 7–8/3 tower transverse width targets.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original sprite-game environment reference and width-study board for Not 3A Game.
Input images: Image 1 is the owner's CHOSEN style reference B — CARTOON 2D. Match specifically the ROAD IN THE BOTTOM GAMEPLAY SCALE STRIP, not the flat showcase background. Image 2 supplies only the established portal and blue soul objective identities.
Primary request: take that broad gray stone road and extend it into a naturally meandering invasion road with variable width. The road must accommodate 7–8 ordinary tower ground footprints SIDE BY SIDE ACROSS broad reaches, and about 3 across short narrow reaches. This is a terrain reference before Unity implementation.
Board composition: wide landscape board. Main image occupies top 72 percent. A clean narrow scale-study strip occupies bottom 25 percent, with two ground cross-section insets at THE SAME SCALE. Small unobtrusive headings only. No large asset-showcase columns.
MAIN IMAGE: high fixed orthographic isometric view of an expansive green meadow crossed by ONE continuous broad worn stone road from the existing dark slate portal with red vortex at upper right to the existing cyan soul sphere/ice dome at lower left. Entire route and endpoints visible. Road bends gently LEFT then RIGHT with two unequal smooth organic curves, so its axis is clearly winding and elongated; do not make a straight capsule/oval arena, enclosed loop, branches, or a narrow uniform ribbon. Substantial green land separates the arms. Broad reaches last long enough for several alternating player-built tower rows; short necks taper smoothly into them. Width of broad reaches: 8 tower FOOTPRINTS, allowing the player to build a maze within the road. Short neck width: 3 footprints. The road edges and proportions must follow those tower units. Tower scale remains uniform throughout the orthographic image. Place only two regular-size familiar Rapid towers and one Longshot as reference objects on separate broad reaches; keep most paving empty. A few small skeletons for object scale. Towers must look small relative to the road breadth, with generous unbuilt pavement on all sides. Do not put decorative collision props in the gray buildable area.
GROUND ART IS THE MAIN SUBJECT: copy the visual language of B's lower strip closely: large softly beveled rectangular gray flagstones in staggered courses aligned with the common isometric ground, slight irregular wear and chipped corners, subtle pale green weeds in the joints, warm earthen patches under short pointed turf, small daisies, shrubs and broken masonry on the grass shoulders. Thin irregular grass intrusion instead of smooth curbs. Large readable hand-drawn shapes, clean expressive outlines, soft restrained shading, warm yellow-green grass and slate stone. Smooth CARTOON 2D SPRITE illustration with painted volume. No pixel art, clay toy look or photorealism. Road follows natural curves while individual rectangular stones remain believable; do not turn the slabs into dense tiny brick mosaic.
BOTTOM SCALE STRIP: neutral subdued background, two clearly separated ground cross sections viewed with the SAME camera and scale as each other, to define usable width independently of main-view foreshortening. Left inset takes about 70% of strip width: a rectangular slice of gray paving exactly wide enough for EIGHT identical Rapid towers side by side ACROSS the road, all eight distinct bases visible, evenly spaced with small gaps, same size and height. Label "WIDE — 8 TOWERS". Right inset takes about 27%: a paving slice exactly wide enough for THREE copies of THE SAME tower at EXACTLY THE SAME SIZE, label "NARROW — 3 TOWERS". These are scale tests, not a proposed blocking defense. Towers can be lightly translucent. Grass borders sit just outside each row end. No ninth tower and no fourth tower; count carefully.
Small main heading "G — B-STYLE WINDING ROAD".
Constraints: original project artwork only, no new tower/enemy roles, no new mechanics, UI, resource costs, numbers other than scale labels, extra road spurs, bridges, cliffs, horizon, geometric lawn islands, tight angular zigzag or straight oval plaza. Preserve natural winding shape AND substantial usable breadth.

refinement_prompt:

It runs diagonally from the middle of the scene toward the bottom-right edge of the main panel and carries one Rapid tower and two skeletons. Remove that entire gray branch, that Rapid and those two skeletons. Replace its area with the same continuous meadow grass, short turf, small flowers and a few shrubs, naturally merging with the existing grass on both sides.
The MAIN scene must now have EXACTLY ONE unbranched road connecting the upper-right red portal to the lower-left cyan soul objective: it runs along the existing upper approach, through the upper-left broad curve, then down the existing left reach to the objective. Keep that remaining winding connection intact and visibly broad, with smooth tapering at the neck. Do not add any new road, junction, fork, loop, dead end, paving spur, road past the objective or obstacle across its usable ground. Retain the surviving Rapid tower near upper-left and catapult near upper-right as scale references.
Preserve ALL other content and the exact established B-style large rectangular worn gray slabs, grass/weeds in joints, broken irregular turf shoulders, consistent isometric camera and cartoon linework.
CRITICAL: the entire BOTTOM SCALE STRIP is locked and must remain unchanged: its left WIDE — 8 TOWERS inset has EIGHT tower copies; its right NARROW — 3 TOWERS inset has THREE, at the SAME size. Do not alter the labels, counts, scale, ground slices, strip framing or top heading. Do not introduce any other content or text.
